title: Evaluate connected static patches with exact rational coefficient MPOs and paid growing-width ranks
statement: For a connected N-site static square-lattice patch with fixed local diamond-strength bound g, paid rational generator/time and positive product input/effect Tr A=2^N, the exact coefficient-MPO algorithm approximates Tr[A exp(tL)rho] to error eta with channel error eta*2^-N. In the polylogarithmic-time and E=O(N polylog N) log-accuracy regime, work is poly(paid input bits,t)*exp[O_g(N^(7/8) polylog N)]. Tilted rational slicing w=O(N^(3/4)), block width b~N^(1/8), CPTP-background rectangular remainders, growing-dimension cut ranks and exact physical-pivot interpolation pay all bit heights. Its use ONLY on N_child=O_rho(L log L) closes the old warm-time recursion after one level. It is a signed numerical polynomial, not a CPTP sampling channel or a general polynomial-size patch oracle.
